analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 44.8 attempting to exit oversold. MACD histogram improved from -5.1382 to 2.1240 but remains in bearish territory. Volume ratio of 0.62 (below 5-day average) indicates weak conviction. Weekly ADX at 33.3 shows a clear trend, but daily directionality is not yet confirmed, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
